N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled at the reporting level.
N_enrolled.long_description: Enrollment count reported by the source. Used as the denominator for the coverage and exemption percentages in the same record.

il_school_immunization.name: Illinois School Immunization Data
il_school_immunization.description: County-level immunization and exemption data from the ISBE public-use immunization data files, published as one sheet per vaccine (Polio, DTaP, Tdap, Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Hepatitis B, Hib, Varicella, Pneumococcal, Meningococcal). Each vaccine carries its own enrollment -- Tdap and Meningococcal assess a 7th/9-12 grade cohort, the rest assess PreK-12 -- so every measure is kept per vaccine rather than collapsed into one antigen's numbers.
il_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data published by the source agency; no access restrictions.
